outcomeNote: aggadic reports of practice and messianic dicta

segments.he: רַבִּי אַבָּא מְנַשֵּׁק כֵּיפֵי דְעַכּוֹ. רַבִּי חֲנִינָא מְתַקֵּן מַתְקָלַיָּה. רַבִּי אַמֵּי וְרַבִּי אַסִּי
segments.en: § «Rabbi Abba would kiss the rocks of Akko,» which was on the coast of Eretz Yisrael. «Rabbi Ḥanina would repair its stumbling blocks,» i.e., any potholes in the land, so that travelers would not fall and consequently speak ill of Eretz Yisrael. «Rabbi Ammi and Rabbi Asi»

segments.he: קָיְימִי מִשִּׁמְשָׁא לְטוּלָּא וּמִטּוּלָּא לְשִׁמְשָׁא. רַבִּי חִיָּיא בַּר גַּמָּדָא מִיגַּנְדַּר בְּעַפְרַהּ, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״כִּי רָצוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶת אֲבָנֶיהָ וְאֶת עֲפָרָהּ יְחוֹנֵנוּ״.
segments.en: «would stand» and pass «from» a «sunny» spot «to» a «shady» one, «and from» a «shady» spot «to» a «sunny» one, so that they would always sit in comfort and never have cause to remark that they were uncomfortable in Eretz Yisrael. «Rabbi Ḥiyya bar Gamda would roll in the dust of» the land, «as it is stated: “For Your servants take pleasure in her stones, and love her dust”» (Psalms 102:15).

segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי זֵירָא אָמַר רַבִּי יִרְמְיָה בַּר אַבָּא: דּוֹר שֶׁבֶּן דָּוִד בָּא — קָטֵיגוֹרְיָא בְּתַלְמִידֵי חֲכָמִים. כִּי אַמְרִיתַהּ קַמֵּיהּ דִּשְׁמוּאֵל אֲמַר צֵירוּף אַחַר צֵירוּף, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״וְעוֹד בָּהּ עֲשִׂירִיָּה וְשָׁבָה וְהָיְתָה לְבָעֵר״. תָּנֵי רַב יוֹסֵף: בָּזוֹזֵי, וּבָזוֹזֵי דְבָזוֹזִי.
segments.en: The Gemara continues to discuss the messianic age. «Rabbi Zeira said» that «Rabbi Yirmeya bar Abba said:» In «the generation in which the son of David» will «come» there will be «indictments [kateigorya],» i.e., denouncements and incitements «against Torah scholars. When I said this before Shmuel he said:» The generation will undergo «refinement after refinement,» i.e., several stages of cleansing, «as it is stated: “And if there be a tenth in it, it shall again be eaten up”» (Isaiah 6:13). «Rav Yosef taught» about the messianic era: «Despoilers and despoilers of despoilers» will plunder Eretz Yisrael at that time.

segments.he: אָמַר רַב חִיָּיא בַּר אָשֵׁי אָמַר רַב: עֲתִידִין כׇּל אִילָנֵי סְרָק שֶׁבְּאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁיִּטְעֲנוּ פֵּירוֹת, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: ״כִּי עֵץ נָשָׂא פִרְיוֹ תְּאֵנָה וָגֶפֶן נָתְנוּ חֵילָם״.
segments.en: «Rav Ḥiyya bar Ashi said» that «Rav said: In the future all barren trees in Eretz Yisrael will bear fruit, as it is stated: “For the tree bears its fruit, the fig tree and the vine yield their strength”» (Joel 2:22). This verse indicates that every tree, not just the fig and vine, will produce fruit.
